According to the latest issue of the *Power On* newsletter, Apple reportedly considered a feature for Apple Upgrade that would make setting up a new iPhone almost seamless: Apple would pre-copy your data to the new device. However, the feature never saw the light of day.

The concept is simple: since consumers upgrade their devices every so often through fixed monthly installments, why not make the transfer process as simple as possible? Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports:

There were evidently some issues. First, your iCloud backup would be slightly out of date, since the data transfer could only happen when the device is shipped, leaving a lag of several days — unless you choose to pick it up in store.

In addition, there are obvious privacy concerns. If you're backing up to iCloud, it shouldn't be surprising that Apple has your data. But for the general public, there might be concerns about how the data gets transferred to the new phone, and worries about whether anyone might peek at the data during the process.

Two years ago, Apple rolled out a new system in its stores called Presto, which lets employees update an iPhone while it's still in the box. One can imagine this system could have been extended to support iCloud backup transfers, without anyone ever needing to look at your data.

Still, the feature never came to fruition — and that might be for the best.

如果我開冷氣，我會通知大家

關於林超英對抗暑熱，公眾最關心的是他開不開冷氣。林超英在周日淩晨首先發文表示：「天氣熱，怎麼辦？風扇、窗簾、氣流、一級能源標籤冷氣機（備用）、27度。今年暫時未開冷氣，如果我開冷氣，我會通知大家，請不用來問。」

林超英：取消也沒分別

網民「不用來問」，但到了下午，香港迎來史上最熱的高溫，天文台錄得36.9度，是1884年有紀錄以來的最高氣溫。勞工處發出黃色工作暑熱警告，原因是雖然8.9氣溫特別高，但相對濕度低於夏天平常情況，加上風速條件良好，天文台在十個地點量度的「香港暑熱指數」，大部分介乎30至少於32之間，勞工處因此根據機制發出黃色工作暑熱警告。

不過，林超英並不認同。他下午先在Facebook發文表示：「熱到這個破紀錄的樣子，還只是黃色工作暑熱警告，加上中暑又不列為工傷，看來這個制度取消了也沒有甚麼分別。」

九個監測站　四個達標會發警告

勞工處晚上回覆《集誌社》查詢時表示，天文台今年四月發布更多地區的暑熱指數數據，勞工處已於4月20日起進一步優化「工作暑熱警告」系統，加入更多地區的暑熱指數數據作為發出「工作暑熱警告」的準則。除了沿用京士柏量度的「香港暑熱指數」數據外，亦加入其他九個地點的數據，作為發出「工作暑熱警告」的準則。

勞工處指出，若其他九個「香港暑熱指數」監測站有四個或以上顯示香港多個地點的熱壓力情況已達某個級別，即使京士柏的指數未達到該水平，勞工處仍會發出對應的「工作暑熱警告」。勞工處表示，會密切留意暑熱天氣及「工作暑熱警告」系統的運作，檢視系統是否需要再作進一步優化。

勞工處：熱壓力致傷亡，僱主須負補償責任

對於林超英指中暑不當工傷的說法，勞工處表示，僱員如在受僱工作期間因工遭遇意外以致受傷或死亡（包括因工作熱壓力意外導致的受傷或死亡），僱主須負起補償責任。至於一宗個案是否屬於工傷及僱主是否須負上僱員補償責任，須按個別個案的事實、具體情況及客觀環境考慮，不能一概而論。

"紅色警告指標顯然定得太高"

晚上氣溫達32度，流浮山更超過34度，林超英再度發文，批評勞工處的工作暑熱警告指標。他指出跑馬地、上水、元朗、西貢都達37度，上水更差點接近40度，「在這樣水深火熱的情況下，工作暑熱警告只是黃色，真的令人迷茫」。他又回應勞工處稱按「香港暑熱指數」發出警告的說法，指「程序也許無誤」，「紅色警告指標顯然定得太高，連氣溫破紀錄都出不了，豈不是只是用來裝飾櫥窗的陳列品？」他同時反駁勞工處對「香港暑熱指數」的解釋。他解釋指，市民大部分時間在室內活動，「香港暑熱指數」中太陽曝曬所佔的份量很少，不適用於露天工作的處境。

建議採用「濕球黑球溫度」為參數

他建議採用國際通用的「濕球黑球溫度」（WBGT）作為參數，因為這能涵蓋太陽曝露對人體加熱的因素。他又指出，黃色工作暑熱警告已發出超過200次，紅色則一次都沒有，「是否有點奇怪」？他要求勞工處向公眾解釋紅色警告指標的科學根據。

向勞工處分享經驗

任內發明暴雨警告系統的林超英亦向勞工處分享經驗，指出天文台訂定暴雨警告指標時，準則是「黑色約一年一次，紅色一年三次，黃色一年十次」，「這樣就不會有永遠不發出的警告」。

Earlier this year, Apple significantly raised the prices of several products in response to the ongoing global shortage of memory chips. Among them, the iPad Air went from US$599 to US$749, the M5 MacBook Pro from US$1,699 to US$1,999, and Apple TV also rose from US$129 to US$199. The above are just some examples, but the key point is that this round of price hikes was quite staggering.

This naturally raises the question — under the new pricing, will Apple put more effort into product improvements to make consumers feel that "the price hike is worth it"?

Of course, major updates for some of Apple's products are already imminent, with the MacBook Pro and iPad mini being two such examples. However, for models that aren't expected to see major changes in the short term, I really cannot imagine how Apple can make "yesterday's technology" still appealing simply by raising the price — especially considering how abundant the second-hand market options are now.

If you could buy an M4 iPad Air for US$599 (or even as low as US$499) a few months ago, why would you pay US$749 now? This logic becomes even more apparent when applied to higher-priced products.

Some of Apple's products have actually gone a long time without major changes. The iPad Air has barely changed in design or features since 2020, with only chip upgrades and added Apple Pencil Pro support. The entry-level iPad has largely remained the same since 2022, and the iMac has seen no major changes from 2021 to this day.

Do these products really need a complete redesign? Not necessarily. But I think Apple definitely has room to add more attractive upgrades on top of the existing pricing. For example, the iMac could get a miniLED display, the iPad Air could be bumped up to a 120Hz refresh rate, and the entry-level iPad could switch to a fully laminated screen.

Compared to the cost of the price hike, the cost of such upgrades is relatively limited, yet effective in making consumers feel that it's "worth buying". Conversely, Apple could also consider "cutting back a little" to offset the pricing pressure — for instance, the iPhone might once again offer a 128GB storage option.

Last September when Apple launched the iPhone 17, the countdown began to breaking a record set 15 years ago by the new flagship model. That record would take over a year to break, but according to current rumours, the iPhone 17 will be the first model to take the crown.

The iPhone 4 had an unusually long sales period

The record belongs to the iPhone 4, which went on sale in June 2010 and remained Apple's top-end iPhone until October 2011. Because Apple shifted its flagship release cycle from summer to autumn that year, the iPhone 4 held the top spot for nearly 16 months.

For customers planning to "wait for the iPhone 5," it was a particularly frustrating period. In its place, Apple launched the iPhone 4S, which looked almost identical to the iPhone 4. The changes were all hidden inside the device: Siri made its debut, the camera was improved, and performance was boosted.

The iPhone 4 also technically went through several launch moments. US carrier AT&T was Apple's exclusive partner in the United States and was the first to sell it. Half a year later, Verizon became the second US carrier to join the sales lineup. Then after a 10-month delay, the long-awaited white version finally appeared.

Since then, no iPhone has managed to break the 15-month flagship sales record set by the iPhone 4. The closest was the iPhone 11 Pro, which held flagship status for 13 months after the iPhone 12 was delayed during the pandemic. Other exceptions exist, such as the gaps between the iPhone SE, SE 2, and iPhone 16e, each spanning over four years, but these were deliberate arrangements, not flagship cycles.

iPhone 17 is expected to break the record (with a key difference)

The iPhone 18 is not expected to arrive until spring 2027. This means the iPhone 17 will occupy the top spot in Apple's main product lineup for about 18 months, surpassing the iPhone 4's record and setting a new benchmark for the longest sales period for a standard iPhone.

Model Launch Replaced by Duration at top iPhone 17 September 2025 iPhone 18, Spring 2027 (expected) ~550 days, ~18 months (projected) iPhone 4 iPhone 4S 477 days, ~15.7 months iPhone 11 Pro iPhone 12 Pro 399 days, ~13.1 months iPhone (2007) iPhone 3G 378 days, ~12.4 months

A key difference between the iPhone 4 era and today is the emergence of the Pro lineup. The long wait from iPhone 4 to iPhone 4S brought a drought of upgrades for customers craving something new.

I think it all depends on how you define "flagship model"

During this cycle from iPhone 17 to iPhone 18, the Pro models will still be updated annually, and Apple's first foldable iPhone is also expected to launch at the same time.

The foldable model will be the most dramatic hardware change in iPhone history, but the iPhone 17 is still expected to claim the record for the longest standard flagship iPhone update cycle.

Shortest iPhone cycle

Incidentally, the shortest interval between iPhone upgrades may come as a surprise. The cycle from iPhone 12 to iPhone 13 lasted only 11 months, when Apple adjusted its launch schedule after a pandemic-related delay.

However, although the iPhone X was announced in September 2017, because the device didn't officially go on sale until November 2017, it was replaced by the iPhone XS just 10 months later.

Eve has been very proactive in supporting Matter and Thread in recent years. This is exactly what you want to see.

The Eve Weather gives you three sets of data in one compact device: temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure. It carries an IPX4 water resistance rating and features an aluminum housing that fits in perfectly outdoors. Mine is mounted right outside. It delivers highly accurate local readings that are often several degrees off from what the Apple Weather app reports. Honestly, that few-degree difference really matters during extreme cold or heat. When your pipes are freezing at 31 degrees Fahrenheit, but the app says 34 degrees, you'll regret not paying attention to local data.

One of the Eve Weather's most underrated features is its built-in 12-hour weather trend display. It uses barometric pressure changes to predict weather trends. You'll see a visual icon indicating whether it's likely to be sunny, cloudy, rainy, or stormy. This small detail brings considerable practical value—you can see it at a glance without having to open a phone app.

Here are a few examples of automations you can set up with the Eve Weather:

  • When temperatures drop below freezing, turn on a colored light to remind family members to drip the faucets.
  • When outdoor humidity is particularly high, activate the dehumidifier.
  • If it's already rained and the forecast shows more rain coming, delay the sprinkler system.
  • Ask Siri from indoors what the temperature is in the front yard right now.

Matter and Thread support in 2026

A few years ago, Eve released a free firmware update that added Matter support to the Eve Weather. If you already own the device, you can upgrade through the Eve app. The Matter version supports Apple Home as well as Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings. The sensor itself remains identical—just now cross-platform compatible, so even if you want to switch to a different primary smart home ecosystem in the future, you won't have to replace the device.

The Eve Weather falls into a category called a "Minimal Thread Device." That means it communicates via Thread but doesn't relay traffic. That job is left to always-on "Full Thread Devices" such as the Eve Energy or Eve Water Guard. The more Full Thread Devices you have, the stronger and more stable your Thread network becomes, and battery-powered devices like the Eve Weather directly benefit from that stability.

You still don't need to create an Eve account. Unless you choose to, everything stays handled locally. The Eve iPhone app is an excellent tool for visualizing and logging historical temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity trends. It's really a great way to spot patterns and make smarter decisions about things like lawn watering and energy management.

I have several HomePod minis around the house, and I also rely on my Eero 6E network to support Thread. Eero has Thread support built into its software, so it provides a solid foundation for accessories like the Eve Weather, keeping them connected and running quickly.

Eve Weather Summary

The only improvement I still really want to see is a rechargeable battery. The current battery life lasts several months, but I'd much prefer a USB-C port like the Eve Room has. Apart from that, the Eve Weather is one of my favorite Apple Home accessories. It's simple, good-looking, and works well across all major platforms, thanks to Matter. If you want to add local weather information to your smart home along with practical automations, the Eve Weather is a no-brainer recommendation from me.

You can buy it on Amazon or directly from the Eve Store.

47 人案 45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，當中 12 名被告提出上訴，今年 2 月被上訴庭駁回，其中 11 人再向高院上訴庭申請，上訴至終審法院的許可證明書。上訴庭今（10日）頒下決定，同意涉案法律論點具重大而廣泛重要性，考慮到是終審法院首次就相關法律議題作裁決，批准 11 人向終審法院上訴。

上訴人為楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄。申請由首席法官潘兆初、上訴庭法官彭偉昌及法官譚耀豪處理。

上訴庭今年 2 月頒下判詞，認為正確詮釋下，《國安法》22 條下的「其他非法手段」，不限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」及刑事行為；又審視特區憲制秩序、立法會憲制職能及議員維護《基本法》的責任，認為涉案謀劃旨在迫中央政府結束一國兩制，顛覆憲制秩序，屬非法手段，而涉案連串行為屬被禁行為、立法會不干預原則不適用，被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制及其後果，具有特定顛覆意圖。至於《基本法》是否容許議員透過否決預算案逼特首問責，上訴庭指具重大憲制意義，但各方陳詞「流於表面」而不作定論。

上訴庭：部分論點未顧及事實背景及法庭裁決

上訴庭今歸納上訴方提出的 5 個議題，包括《國安法》22 條下「其他非法手段」的正確詮釋為何；觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制是否構成「其他非法手段」；立法會議員的憲制責任、權力及職能是什麼，及涉案「連串行為」是否「受禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；及意圖觸發《基本法》50 至 52 條機制，是否構成顛覆政權的特定意圖。上訴庭指，上述論點顯然與上訴理據大幅相似，但部分似乎未有充分顧及本案的事實背景及法庭裁決。

上訴庭指，考慮雙方書面陳詞後，認為判決所涉的主要議題，具有重大而廣泛重要性，當中涉及《國安法》第 22 條的控罪元素，包括犯罪行為及犯罪意圖；以及立法會議員履行憲制職能的責任，特別是關於審核財政預算案及啟動《基本法》第 50 至 52 條機制的事宜。上訴庭指，相關爭議值得終審法院考慮，尤其這是終審法院首次就相關事宜作出裁決。

就五項法律議題批終極上訴許可證明書

上訴庭遂就以下 5 個議題，批出上訴至終審法院的許可證明書，包括按照國安法 22 條，何謂「其他非法手段」，是否只局限於「使用武力或威脅使用武力」或刑事行為；涉案的「謀劃」或「連串行為」是否條文所指的「非法手段」及「被禁行為」；立法會不干預原則是否適用；以及被告意圖觸發《基本法》第 50 至 52 條所訂機制及其帶來的後果，是否懷有特定的顛覆意圖。

47 人案中，45 名被告串謀顛覆國家政權罪成，其中 12 人包括楊雪盈、黃碧雲、鄒家成、余慧明、何桂藍、林卓廷、吳政亨、鄭達鴻、何啟明、陳志全、梁國雄、黃子悅早前提出上訴，在今年 2 月下旬被全數駁回；律政司就劉偉聰脫罪的上訴亦同被駁回。除黃子悅外，其餘 11 名被告再申請上訴至終審法院，向上訴庭申請上訴許可證明書。而律政司則至限期屆滿前，未有對劉偉聰的無罪裁決提出上訴。

【某部門】反對公開數據 改制「香港暑熱指數」

林超英重申應使用濕球、黑球溫度指標，他憶述，當年相關的公測，幾乎已經定好，天文台曾準備向香港公開這項數據，但受到「某部門」反對，有擔憂公布濕球、黑球溫度會引起勞工界注意，所以要求天文台另行制訂一個不適用於露天情況的指標，這就是如今政府引用的「香港暑熱指數」。

指兩者絕對不相似

林超英指，兩者絕對不相似。香港暑熱指數避開了露天工作的情況，未有處理在太陽下曝曬的情形。他指出，所有相關指數，都是用三組數據，分別為氣溫、黑球溫度、濕球溫度，只是比重不同。

他舉例指，日本採用濕球黑球溫度，當達到28度以上，工作超過一小時，一旦中暑就要「立案處理」。他指現時「警告出多咗」，反而令市民「搞亂咗」。他說，有人認為，天文台一出極端酷熱天氣提示，就轉發紅色暑熱工作警告，已能減少民間感到混亂的情況。他說：「晒咗咁多紀錄喎，仲係度賴天文台，跟住唔出紅色，呢個真係離地，脫離現實。」

One of the most frustrating elements of the iPhone user interface is that we have to play a guessing game just to change a setting for a particular app.

Sometimes we open the app itself and go into its built-in settings menu. But other times we have to exit the app and open the completely separate Apple "Settings" app — an experience so clunky it's unbelievable (although there is a free shortcut that can help)…

The Settings Problem

We've all been in this situation. We want to change a setting for an app, so we go to the hamburger menu, select Settings, and look for the item we want to change. We can't find it, and only then do we realize we need to exit the app, open Apple's own Settings app, search for that app, make the change there, and finally reopen the app we originally wanted to use.

The process itself is already clumsy enough, and the fact that we also have to guess where to start looking makes things even worse.

Take Apple's own Camera app as an example. Recent iPhones offer what Apple calls the 1x lens of the Fusion Camera. The default is 24mm, but we can change its default to 28mm or 35mm. This works by the app applying an automatic crop. Additionally, we can choose whether tapping the 1x button cycles through the different focal lengths.

But unless it's hidden somewhere I haven't found, there's no way to do this from within the Camera app itself. Instead, we have to open the Settings app, scroll down to Camera*, scroll down to the Photo Capture section, tap Fusion Camera — and only then can we make our selection.

*Not to mention we also have to guess whether an Apple app's settings will have their own section in Settings, or whether they'll be placed under the Apps section…

A Shortcut Provides a Partial Solution

We can't avoid the guessing game, but at least there's a useful third-party shortcut made by Quinn Nelson of Snazzy Labs that can take a little of the sting out.

Thanks to John Gruber for introducing me to this shortcut. If you'd like to install it yourself:

  • Download and install it here
  • Open Control Center
  • Tap the + button in the top-left corner
  • Tap Add a Control at the bottom
  • Search for Shortcuts
  • Tap Run Shortcut
  • Select the App Settings shortcut

Once installed, if you're using an app and find you need to look for a setting in the separate Settings app, simply swipe down from the top-right corner to open Control Center, then tap the App Settings button.

But Apple Should Properly Fix This Problem

However, I'd much rather see a proper solution than a handy third-party workaround.

My suggestion is that every app's settings menu should always have a "More" option at the bottom — tapping it would automatically open the Settings app and jump to the correct page. That way, if we can't find what we need in the app's own settings menu, the setting we're after is always just one more tap away.

To be clear, Apple already provides an API to do this, but relatively few developers use it. I'd like to see Apple make this a mandatory requirement.

Is there anything you'd like to see? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

Retired barrister Margaret Ng was convicted of participating in an unauthorised assembly in the 8.18流水式集會案 (the August 18 water-style assembly case) and sentenced to nine months' imprisonment, suspended for two years. She was complained of professional misconduct by the Bar Association, but the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal ruled by a large majority in June this year that the complaint was not established. The Executive Committee of the Bar Association filed a judicial review last Friday (7th), seeking to have the court set aside the ruling, declare the complaint established, and order the tribunal to issue a reprimand letter to Ng, or remand the case to a differently constituted tribunal for reconsideration. The Bar Association argued that the tribunal's finding that Ng's conduct did not merit moral condemnation and was not shameful was inconsistent with the original judgment and amounted to a collateral attack on the criminal court. It also stressed that Ng's conduct sent a wrong message to the public—that during politically turbulent times, barristers could openly disregard the law—setting a bad example for Hong Kong people. 集誌社 (The Collective) contacted Ng about the matter; she replied via text message saying "no comments".

In 2021, Margaret Ng was convicted of knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly in the August 18 water-style assembly case. (File photo)

Professional misconduct complaint not established

The applicant is the Executive Committee of the Hong Kong Bar Association. The proposed respondent is the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal consisting of Senior Counsel Eva Sit (郭莎樂), barrister Lily Ching (趙芷筠) and Olivia Sze (施麗珊). The interested party is Margaret Ng.

According to the originating summons, Ng was admitted as a barrister in 1988 and practised until 31 December 2025. She was convicted of knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly in the August 18 water-style assembly case and sentenced to nine months' imprisonment, suspended for two years. The Bar Association considered that her conduct might have damaged the reputation of the bar, or undermined public confidence in the profession, in breach of the Code of Conduct. However, the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal ruled by a large majority on 8 June this year that the complaint was not established.

Applicant: Tribunal ruling inconsistent with original judgment

The originating summons stated that the tribunal's decision to dismiss the complaint was fundamentally wrong. The Bar Association brought the judicial review to fulfil its regulatory duties and promote public confidence. The applicant cited the trial judge, who said the defendants had deliberately flouted the law, used the false pretext of "dispersing the crowd" to circumvent the prohibition, and had premeditatedly challenged police authority, the law and order, and deliberately broken the law and challenged public order during turbulent times. The offence was considered serious and unacceptable, especially when committed by barristers whom the public expected to respect and uphold the rule of law.

The applicant further stated that the tribunal had misdirected itself and misunderstood legal principles, failing to focus on whether Ng had breached the Bar Association's Code of Conduct, instead considering abstractly whether there was "professional misconduct". The tribunal's ruling that Ng's criminal conduct did not merit moral condemnation and was not shameful was inconsistent with the original judgment and amounted to an impermissible "collateral attack" on the criminal court's decision.

The applicant also considered that the tribunal had wrongly taken Ng's political motives into account, stating that the courts had always applied the law strictly and must keep politics out of judicial proceedings. The tribunal's consideration of her political motives and use of them to justify her conduct exceeded the proper bounds of legal analysis. Even under the tribunal's logic, Ng believed she was doing the right thing, but according to case law, a knowing and deliberate challenge to the law—even for a worthy cause—still damages the reputation of the legal profession and constitutes professional misconduct. Moreover, Ng chose not to follow lawful channels, but instead took the law into her own hands to advance her political motives, causing serious division in Hong Kong society.

In the August 18 water-style assembly case, Leung Kwok-hung, Jimmy Lai, Lee Cheuk-yan, Margaret Ng, Albert Ho, Martin Lee and Cyd Ho were convicted at trial of both "organising an unauthorised assembly" and "knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly", and sentenced to between 8 and 18 months' imprisonment. Martin Lee, Margaret Ng and Albert Ho received suspended sentences. Their convictions for "organising an unauthorised assembly" were later overturned on appeal.

Applicant: Ng's open defiance of the law sets a bad example

As for the tribunal's finding that there was insufficient connection between Ng's offence and her status as a barrister, the applicant also considered this to be in error. The original trial noted that three of the defendants were legally trained and highly experienced lawyers who were undoubtedly familiar with the Public Order Ordinance. The applicant stated that Ng must have been among them. When three lawyers were seen by the public holding banners and leading an unlawful march, the message sent to the public was that even experienced lawyers saw no problem with deliberately and knowingly breaking the law. This damaged Hong Kong's rule of law, and the body that regulated barristers could not possibly tolerate it.

The applicant further pointed out that the tribunal seemed to imply that because Ng had devoted most of her time to the Legislative Council, her conduct was unrelated to her profession as a barrister. However, the applicant stated that the complaint was not about how much time Ng had spent in practice. Precisely because Ng was a well-known political figure and the public knew she was a barrister, her wrongful and unacceptable conduct in placing herself above the law sent a completely wrong message to the public—especially during turbulent times of high political emotions—that as long as one subjectively disagreed with the law and believed one was doing the right thing, even an experienced barrister and former legal-sector legislator could accept openly disregarding the law. This undoubtedly set a bad example for Hong Kong people, particularly those who shared her political views.

Margaret Ng, Albert Ho, Martin Lee and the other defendants appealed their convictions for participating in an unauthorised assembly to the Court of Final Appeal, arguing that the prosecution and convictions infringed freedom of assembly. The appeal was dismissed in 2024. (File photo)

Application seeks to set aside ruling and order reprimand

The Bar Association finally stated that it understood Ng had retired at the end of 2025, but emphasised that correcting a fundamental legal error remained important to the public interest so as to maintain public confidence in the bar. The Association asked the court to set aside the tribunal's ruling, declare the complaint against Ng established, and order the tribunal to issue a reprimand letter to Ng, or order the complaint to be reconsidered by a differently constituted tribunal. Even if the judicial review succeeded, the applicant would not apply for costs.

According to information, all barristers are subject to the Code of Conduct. If the Executive Committee of the Bar Association, upon receiving a complaint or for other reasons, considers that a barrister's conduct should be investigated, it must refer the matter to the convenor of a Discretionary Tribunal of the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal Panel. The Panel operates independently; its members are all appointed by the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal. Members of the Bar Association's Executive Committee are not eligible to be appointed or to remain as Panel members. After a complaint is referred, the convenor will appoint one Senior Counsel, one barrister and one non-legal person from the Panel to conduct the inquiry. If professional misconduct is found, the tribunal has the power to impose disciplinary sanctions, including censure, fines, temporary suspension or formal striking off.

美國西部和加拿大週日發生的山火，讓部分居民時刻警惕可能的疏散命令，而其他已被迫逃離家園的人則在等待返回時看看還剩下甚麼。

在加拿大西岸，英屬哥倫比亞省奧肯納根湖沿岸社區有超過兩萬人在週末被迫撤離，期間一場迅速蔓延的山火摧毀房屋，數十人需由飛機救出。在美國華盛頓州，消防員連日來在斯波坎地區撲滅三場已燃燒逾週的山火，週日繼續在封鎖線附近進行清理。

Laurie Allen上週末與丈夫、狗和兩隻小貓離開斯波坎以北的Nine Mile Falls社區，當時山火在附近不遠處焚燒。通往她社區的道路週日仍然封閉，但她說從朋友口中得知，雖然覆蓋著灰燼，但她的房子和附近其他房屋都完好無損。

Allen說：「我在這裡住了65年，從未發生過這種事。我們當時甚麼都沒想，只顧著抓起動物就走。但現在它影響了我們周圍這麼多親朋好友，所以實在令人心碎。」

加拿大兩萬多人因山火撤離

在加拿大，Anette Boulet是撤離居民之一，她離開的是英屬哥倫比亞省奧肯納根湖沿岸、人口約一萬二的Summerland。她和家人在週六凌晨約四點半撤離時，家園已被濃煙籠罩。

Boulet撤離到Penticton的一個中心後說：「當時幾乎看不見，周圍一片漆黑，火勢沿著山脊向你撲來。」

她說：「那種恐懼，無法用言語形容。」

皇家加拿大騎警週日稍後表示，一名80歲老婦在試圖逃離奧肯納根湖地區的山火時死亡。

除Summerland的疏散外，週五晚首次接報的Bald Range山火亦導致附近Peachland一帶約八千人撤離。英屬哥倫比亞省週六宣布進入緊急狀態。

加拿大緊急管理及社區韌力部長Eleanor Olszewski週日在社交媒體表示，她已批准英屬哥倫比亞省的聯邦援助請求，為被迫撤離的人士提供庇護和住宿。

斯波坎地區山火令居民提心吊膽

管理斯波坎地區三場山火的團隊發布新聞稿指，消防員週日繼續在封鎖線附近進行「清理善後工作」，三場山火均未再擴大。這些山火過去一週來已焚毀或損毀約920棟建築物。

本週較早時，一名男子被捕並被指控蓄意縱火，引發斯波坎地區三場山火中最大的一場。

位於斯波坎以南約35英里（55公里）的小型鄉鎮Malden，居民週六被要求立即疏散。然而到了週日，其疏散級別被下調，改為準備在必要時迅速撤離。

為Malden提供食水合約的公司負責人John Goyke表示：「目前風勢平靜，火勢未有蔓延，但我們正透過社交媒體和Facebook與所有人保持聯絡。」

Goyke亦是附近Rosalia的市長，他說Malden居民已被告知節約用水，以便在有需要時留給消防車使用，而Malden消防部門一直從Rosalia運水到當地。

2020年，Malden大部分地區被山火摧毀，消防局、郵局、市政廳和圖書館全部付之一炬。

直升機墜毀 兩名滅火機師殉職

在猶他州，兩名直升機機師週五早上在Fishlake國家森林撲滅山火期間墜機罹難。救援人員週六終於抵達現場，證實兩人死訊。

官員週日表示，由於地勢陡峭崎嶇，火場附近的火勢令他們無法迅速到場。

Sevier縣警長Nathan Curtis說：「我們初到現場時，可以看到兩道不同的煙柱，一道來自墜機現場，一道來自正向我們逼近的活躍火場。」

美國國家運輸安全委員會正在調查肇事原因。

早前一直有傳聞指，蘋果正為明年iPhone面世20週年研發一款全玻璃新設計的iPhone。不過，Jefferies一名分析師認為該款裝置已不會再繼續推進。

華爾街分析師指，針對iPhone 20週年的大改版設計計劃已被取消

華爾街投資銀行Jefferies今日將蘋果股票評級下調至「跑輸大市」，分析師李（Edison Lee）更將可能取消iPhone 20週年大改版設計列為主要原因之一。

是次降級的關鍵，在於市場猜測蘋果的全玻璃iPhone計劃已被取消。雖然該項目早於2025年已有消息指正在研發，並有傳聞指最快可於2027年面世，但蘋果從未就相關揣測作出回應。不過，公司早於2019年曾靜悄悄地就一款「六面玻璃外殼」提交專利申請。Jefferies一度認為推出全玻璃iPhone是合理可行，但李如今認為相關開發工作已經停�。該分析師表示，供應鏈方面的核查顯示，項目因良率過低而被取消。李認為此決定「是在記憶體成本飆升之際，推動推出更高定價iPhone工作的一大挫敗」。若果如期於2027年9月推出以紀念iPhone面世20週年，該裝置的估計混合零售價將達2,060美元，高於以往任何型號的平均售價。李寫道：「更重要的是，我們相信原定計劃是將全玻璃設計延伸至未來的iPhone Pro及Pro Max型號，進一步提高其平均售價及利潤。」他認為，在記憶體價格上升的形勢下，此舉本是一項重要的防守策略。

李同時指出，蘋果的AI策略，以及iPhone 19 Pro零件成本上升，亦是下調該公司股票評級的進一步原因。

從李的分析報告中，未能確定他認為是整個改版設計已被擱置，抑或僅有部分設計元素遭棄。

例如，早前已有揣測指，蘋果明年將無法完全移除Dynamic Island的開孔設計，因此無法實現「全玻璃」屏幕。但傳聞中的四曲面設計或許仍有望面世。

無論如何，假如蘋果iPhone 20週年紀念設計確實已被取消，相信短期內會有其他具公信力的消息來源加以證實。
